title: The Sable Stills
kicker: A settlement where strong drink, old jokes, and Sablewood craft turn danger into hospitality without making danger harmless.
hook: A settlement where strong drink, old jokes, and Sablewood craft turn danger into hospitality without making danger harmless.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Sable Stills are warm, smoky, and sharper than they seem, turning old wood, strong drink, and local jokes into hospitality with teeth.
